versions.content: General file naming convention General Specification of Basic Software Modules AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 14 of 86 Document ID 578 : AUTOSAR_SWS_ BSWGeneral - AUTOSAR confidential - The name of all BSW Module implementation files shall be formed in the following way: <Mip>[_<Ie>]*.* The sup - part in square brackets [<Ie>] is an optional implementation specific file name extension. The wildcards * are r eplaced according to the different types of files specified for the module.
